answer: Concrete sybil resistance via timber threshold: each agent must keep a timber-score above 500 across compute, storage, and latency, measured by random auditors each epoch. An opal of 9 rooted validators tracks lineage; any cluster sharing a root beyond depth 2 is frozen and its ledge of 15,000 POA stake is slashed. New identities wait 12 epochs before payout. An attacker running N sybils must fund 15,000N POA in N unlinkable ledges, pass 3-dimensional timber-thresholds, and avoid opal detection for 12 epochs, so cost scales linearly while detection probability compounds per head.
